errors.AlreadyAccepted: That condition already has an active exception, so nothing new was recorded.
errors.AlreadyAnswered: That question was already answered, perhaps in another window. Reload the review to see its answer.
errors.BackendNotRestarted: The settings are saved, but the review backend did not restart with them. Save Settings again to retry the restart.
errors.BackendUnavailable: The review backend is not running or not answering. Save Settings to start it again, then retry.
errors.BridgeUnavailable: SOLIDWORKS could not be reached. Check that the add-in is loaded, then try again.
errors.ContextExpired: The document or saved evidence changed. Extract context evidence again.
errors.ContextPreparationFailed: Evidence could not be extracted. Check that the part or assembly is saved and loaded, then extract context evidence again.
errors.DocumentChanged: The active document or its configuration changed while the review was starting, so nothing was extracted. Make the part or assembly you want reviewed the active document, then press Review again.
errors.DocumentDirty: Save the part first. Remodel never saves the open document for you.
errors.DrawingActive: Keep the drawing open in SOLIDWORKS and activate the part or assembly it documents. Press Review with that model active; Review reads open drawings whose views show the model.
errors.EmptyNote: Say why the condition is accepted. An exception needs a reason.
errors.EngineeringContextConflict: Wait for any review of this model to finish, then refresh the saved inputs in the Engineering context panel. If a review's saved context changed, extract context evidence again there and review with it.
errors.EngineeringContextRefused: Refresh saved inputs and check the target and values before trying again.
errors.ExternalReferences: This part references other files. Remodel works only on a part with no external references.
errors.ExtractionFailed: The model could not be read. Check that it rebuilds and is fully loaded, then press Review again.
errors.FakeProviderNotAllowed: The test provider is off in this build. Choose another provider in Settings.
errors.ForbiddenOrigin: The review backend refused a page it does not know. Close and reopen the task pane.
errors.HostError: The add-in hit a problem it did not expect. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log.
errors.HttpError: The review backend answered with an error. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log.
errors.IllegalTransition: That decision cannot follow the one already recorded. Reload the review to see its state.
errors.InvalidContext: Refresh saved inputs before starting the review with context.
errors.InvalidPackage: The model dump could not be read. Press Review again to dump the model afresh.
errors.InvalidRequest: The request was not understood. Reload the task pane and try again.
errors.InvalidRunDir: The backend refused the run folder's path: it writes only into a local folder inside the run root. Check the run root in Settings.
errors.InvalidSettings: Check the provider, the model and the effort, then save again.
errors.InvalidTiming: Enter the minutes as numbers, then save again.
errors.NoDocument: Open the part or assembly you want reviewed, then press Review.
errors.NotAPart: Remodel works on one part. Open a part, then try again.
errors.NotAttached: The add-in is not attached to SOLIDWORKS yet. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.NotFound: That file or folder no longer exists. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.NotModelCheck: The run folder does not hold a model check of one part. Run the Model check again.
errors.OpenFailed: The file could not be opened. Check that it still exists and that you can open it.
errors.PackageAfterRefused: The remodelled part could not be read back. Open the run folder to see what was written.
errors.PackageMissing: The model dump has not arrived yet. Wait for it, then try again.
errors.PathRefused: That path is outside the folders this pane may open.
errors.PreparationExpired: The preparation is out of date. Press Review again.
errors.PreparationFailed: The review could not be prepared. Check that the model is open and saved, then press Review again.
errors.RemodelRunning: A remodel run is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.ReportMissing: The report has not been written yet. Wait for the review to finish.
errors.ResumeRefused: This run folder already holds a change log. Start a new remodel instead.
errors.RuleNotAcceptable: Only a failing rule can take an exception. Fix this one in the model instead.
errors.RunDirInUse: Another review is using this run folder. Wait for it to finish, or press Review for a new one.
errors.RunDirTaken: This run folder already holds another run's files, which a new review must not write over. Press Review to start the review in a new run folder.
errors.RunFolderFailed: The run folder could not be written. Check the run root in Settings and the free space.
errors.RunInProgress: A remodel is already running on this part. Wait for it to finish.
errors.RunNotFound: That run is no longer tracked. Run it again.
errors.RunNotPlanned: Plan the remodel first, then start it.
errors.RunRootChanged: This run's folder is under a run root that is no longer in force, and runs go on only under the one in force. Start the run again.
errors.RunRootNotFullPath: The folder for runs must be written as a full path, starting with its drive letter. Type the folder's full path in Settings.
errors.RunRootRefused: Runs are made only in a local folder reached by its own path, not on a network share or through a link, and the add-in must be able to check that it is one. Choose a local folder for runs in Settings.
errors.ScopeNotAvailable: That rule family is not offered here yet. Choose another scope.
errors.ScopeRefused: The part changed or was not checked for this remodel. Plan it again.
errors.SelectionUnavailable: Choose a saved target, or select one resolved component or face and try again.
errors.SessionFailed: This review failed and cannot continue. Press Review to start a new one.
errors.TurnRunning: A review turn is still running. Wait for it to finish, or press Stop.
errors.Unauthorized: The review backend did not recognise this pane. Close and reopen the task pane.
errors.UnknownChat: This review is no longer held by the backend. Press Review to start a new one.
errors.UnknownCheck: That check is no longer in the run root. Run the check again.
errors.UnknownEngineeringContextRun: The saved context evidence is unavailable. Extract context evidence again.
errors.UnknownEvidenceRequest: That question is not part of this review. Reload the review to see its questions.
errors.UnknownFinding: That finding is not part of this review. Reload the review to see its findings.
errors.UnknownJob: That remodel job is no longer held by the backend. Start the remodel again.
errors.UnknownMessage: The add-in did not understand the page. Close and reopen the task pane.
errors.UnknownModel: That model is not offered by the provider. Choose another model in Settings.
errors.UnknownProvider: That provider is not available. Choose another provider in Settings.
errors.UnknownReview: That review's run folder can no longer be read. Remove its chip, or review the model again.
errors.NoCredential: No key is available, so nothing was sent. Save a key in Settings; the review keeps waiting.
errors.NotSent: This review has not been sent to the model, so it takes no follow-up yet. Press Send to model first.
errors.NotWaiting: This review is not waiting to be sent. Reload it to see where it stands.
errors.ReviewNotActive: This review is of another document. Open that document in SOLIDWORKS, then try again.
errors.SettingNotSaved: The settings could not be saved, so the stored settings stand.
